notes: A Learnings tab: everything the team has taught the app about the PeoplesHR code, filterable by module and searchable.
Add a learning by hand; it goes to the shared shelf straight away (or with the next update if you are offline).
Correct one: the old wording stays on the shelf with who changed it; if someone changed it while you were reading, you see their version.
Retire one that is wrong or out of date, with a reason; it stops reaching runs but stays visible.
The shelf moved to its own place, PeoplesHR-Learnings; your existing learnings move across on their own.
